text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove two City-owned trees located at 18 Raeburn Avenue. The application indicates the reasons for removal are to meet the energy efficiency requirements for the certification of a proposed passive house. The subject trees are two Colorado blue spruces (Picea pungens), measuring 39 cm and 50 cm in diameter. The Tree By-law does not support the removal of these trees as they are healthy and maintainable.

North York Community Council: 1. Referred this item to the Director, Urban Forestry, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, with a request that the matter be resubmitted to the North York Community Council once the revised Tree Policy is in place.
